entries.title: A runbook can bring its own panels
entries.body: A runbook can now include panels, which show on your rails while the runbook is on and go away when you turn it off. Settings → Runbooks names each runbook's panels under its switch. When you add a runbook from elsewhere, its card lists the panels it brings and what each can read, and adding it agrees to them.

picture.alt: A Reading list panel on the right rail, attributed to the Reading desk runbook that brought it
